items.title: Michael Moore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: Whitney Balliett called 'the greatest living bassist.' ... I did one whole room in that article.

ctx.x: Michael was interviewed on September 12, 1997 at the Allegheny Jazz Party in Chautauqua, New York by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

We are filming this afternoon for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive in Chautauqua, New York, and I am very pleased to welcome Michael Moore, who Whitney Balliett called “the greatest living bassist.” Did you see that quote?

Did I see it — I did one whole room in that article. Well, yeah, I did. Actually it was nice to read but it was tough to live with because I mean I didn’t agree, and it’s the kind of thing that made a lot of enemies. People I didn’t even know would come up to me and say, like I wrote it.
